candidates.title: The Greenwood Jig
candidates.description: Bright fingerstyle jig in D Mixolydian over open-string drones; a hummable hook with the flat-7th C, a lifting B part, a soft sparse "air" pass, then home.

candidates.title: Hollow Oak Lullaby
candidates.description: Gentle 3/4 waltz-lullaby in A Dorian for two nylon guitars: ringing arpeggios, a wistful-but-warm tune built on the Dorian F#, a B part that lifts to C and G, and soft harmonics chimes.

candidates.title: The Wanderer's Road
candidates.key: G major (B part in E minor)
candidates.description: Ambling 4/4 travis-picked wanderer's tune for two steel guitars: alternating thumb bass, a cheerful syncopated pentatonic melody, an E-minor B part that climbs to A5, and a G→D7 turnaround into the loop.

candidates.title: The Mossy Tankard
candidates.description: Cheeky 2/4 tavern-in-the-woods polka in E Dorian: bouncing root/fifth bass and off-beat chops on nylon, a staccato steel-string tune with rests and octave hops, a B part lifting to G and A major, and a stop-time pass.
